correctness.rationale: For all strict total orders on n labeled elements with pair-comparison instances, a fixed query support is VC-shattered iff its undirected graph is a forest; so VCdim=n−1, including n=1. A depth-d complete adaptive mistake tree requires 2^d distinct hypotheses, giving Ldim<=floor(log2(n!)). The actual complete `order_certificates.json` contains depth 1,2,4,6,9 trees for n=2..6; every internal queried pair and all 2,4,16,64,512 leaf witness permutations were independently checked against full root-to-leaf answer histories, with no duplicate witness and correct hypothesis counts. This is exhaustive finite certificate for only n<=6, not an induction or claim for larger n. The n=1 value is zero.
